profile.dailyDigestHint: Receive your edition every morning at {time} · {timezone}

edition.hint: Sets the language of your daily digest, quiz and email — and of the app. The language menu in the sidebar changes only what you see on screen.
edition.saveFailed: Could not save the digest language

byok.intro: Plug in your own Anthropic, Google AI, or OpenAI key and your daily digest is generated against your account, not ours. Keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM at rest and never returned by any endpoint after you save them.

addModal.body: Re-enter your password and paste a key from {provider}. We'll send it a tiny test request to confirm it works before storing it.
addModal.replaceNotice: You already have a {provider} key on file — saving replaces it. The new key is validated before it goes live.

removeModal.title: Remove {provider} key
removeModal.body: Re-enter your password to remove this key. Future digests will use the platform's key.

errors.tooShort: Key looks too short. Double-check the value.

toasts.savedUnvalidated: Key saved but not validated — it won't be used until validated

danger.body: Permanently delete your account, your edition history, your quiz scores, and all associated data. The press will go quiet for you. This cannot be undone.
danger.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account? All your editions, quiz history, and preferences will be permanently removed.
